description: Passenger app: (a) enhance RideRequestScreen with geocoding autocomplete + real map + route polyline + real fare from backend, (b) create MapRouteScreen full-screen map, (c) enhance TripActiveScreen with real route polyline + live driver marker + ETA + arrival banner. Independent of FEAT-003 (driver app). Depends on FEAT-001 backend endpoints.
steps: READ apps/passenger-app/screens/RideRequestScreen.tsx before editing. Replace the entire file. Key changes: (1) Add state: pickupCoords: {lat:number;lng:number}|null, destinationCoords: {lat:number;lng:number}|null, pickupSuggestions: {label:string;lat:number;lng:number}[], destinationSuggestions same, polylineCoords: [number,number][], routeLoading: boolean, mapRef = useRef<MapView>(null). (2) Replace the fake mapArea <View> with a real <MapView provider={PROVIDER_GOOGLE} ref={mapRef} style={styles.map} region={...}>. When both coords set render <Polyline coordinates={polylineCoords.map(p=>({latitude:p[0],longitude:p[1]}))} strokeColor='#00d46a' strokeWidth={4} />, <Marker coordinate={{latitude:pickupCoords.lat,longitude:pickupCoords.lng}}> with Text '📍' emoji child </Marker>, <Marker coordinate={{latitude:destinationCoords.lat,longitude:destinationCoords.lng}}> with Text '🏁' child </Marker>. (3) Geocode autocomplete function fetchSuggestions(text): debounced 400ms. Try ORS: GET https://api.openrouteservice.org/geocode/autocomplete?api_key=${process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_ORS_API_KEY??''}&text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}&boundary.country=TZ&size=5 with axios. If ORS key empty or request fails, fallback to Nominatim: GET https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(text)}&countrycodes=tz&format=json&limit=5. Map both responses to {label: string, lat: number, lng: number}. ORS response: features[].properties.label + geometry.coordinates[1]/[0]. Nominatim: display_name + lat/lon (parse floats). (4) Show suggestion FlatList below each input (max 5 items, dark bg #16213e, touchable rows). On suggestion select: set coords + text + clear suggestions. (5) When both pickupCoords and destinationCoords set: call async calculateRoute() which POSTs to `${API_BASE}/tracking/calculate-route` with {from_lat, from_lng, to_lat, to_lng, trip_id: 'preview'}; on success set polylineCoords, setEstimatedFare(result.fare_tzs), setEstimatedTime(result.duration_minutes); fit map to polyline bounds via mapRef.current.fitToCoordinates(). (6) Fare card label: 'Nauli ya Kawaida: Sh X,XXX'. Pickup placeholder: 'Mahali pa kuanzia'. Destination placeholder: 'Unaenda wapi?'. (7) 'Tafuta Dereva' button (was 'Confirm Ride') navigates to TripActive with {pickup, pickupCoords, destination, destinationCoords, fare: estimatedFare, polylineCoords, paymentMethod}. (8) Dark bg #1a1a2e, green #00d46a accents, borderRadius 12 cards. Keep existing vehicle selector and payment modal.

CREATE apps/passenger-app/screens/MapRouteScreen.tsx. Full-screen map screen that can be navigated to from TripActiveScreen. Props via route.params: { pickupCoords: {lat:number;lng:number}, destinationCoords: {lat:number;lng:number}, polylineCoords: [number,number][], driverCoords: {lat:number;lng:number}|null, etaMinutes: number }. Render: <MapView provider={PROVIDER_GOOGLE} style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} ref={mapRef}>. <Polyline> green route. 📍 pickup Marker, 🏁 destination Marker, 🚕 driver Marker (only when driverCoords non-null). ETA pill: absolute top:50 right:16, bg rgba(0,0,0,0.7), borderRadius 16, Text 'Unafika dakika {etaMinutes}' color #fff. Recenter button: absolute bottom:40 right:16, bg #00d46a, borderRadius 28, size 56, calls mapRef.current?.animateToRegion(centeredOnDriver or pickup). Back arrow top-left calls navigation.goBack(). No navigation.navigate calls needed — this is a detail view only.

Add MapRoute to passenger App.tsx stack: add import MapRouteScreen from './screens/MapRouteScreen'; then add <Stack.Screen name='MapRoute' component={MapRouteScreen} options={{ headerShown: false }} /> inside the Stack.Navigator.

EDIT apps/passenger-app/screens/TripActiveScreen.tsx. Changes: (a) Accept new route params: pickupCoords?: {lat:number;lng:number}, destinationCoords?: {lat:number;lng:number}, polylineCoords?: [number,number][]. Add to the TripRouteProps type. (b) Add state: polylineCoords: [number,number][], pickupCoords: {lat:number;lng:number}|null, destinationCoords: {lat:number;lng:number}|null, showArrivalBanner: boolean. On mount: if params.polylineCoords provided use them; else call POST /tracking/calculate-route with pickup/destination coords (if available). (c) In the MapView section: add <Polyline coordinates={polylineCoords.map(p=>({latitude:p[0],longitude:p[1]}))} strokeColor='#00d46a' strokeWidth={4} />. (d) Refactor the pickup and destination Markers to use actual pickupCoords/destinationCoords instead of region ± 0.005 offsets. (e) In fetchLocation (the 5s poll): use GET /tracking/trip/${tripId}/driver-location (already coded). After getting driverLocation: compute haversine distance from driver to destinationCoords; if < 0.2 km set showArrivalBanner(true). Compute remaining distance and update ETA. (f) Status label: when status==='accepted' show 'Dereva yako anakuja', when status==='in_progress' show 'Safari inaendelea'. (g) Show arrival banner when showArrivalBanner: a View overlaid at bottom of map area with green bg, Text 'Unafika!' fontSize 20 fontWeight bold. (h) All existing dark-theme styles preserved.
Run cd apps/passenger-app && npx tsc --noEmit and fix all TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit in apps/passenger-app exits with 0 errors
RideRequestScreen shows geocoding suggestion dropdown when typing in pickup or destination fields
RideRequestScreen renders a real MapView (not placeholder View) with green Polyline and 📍/🏁 markers after both locations are selected
Fare card shows Swahili label 'Nauli ya Kawaida' with fare from backend
MapRouteScreen renders without TypeScript errors and is registered in App.tsx
TripActiveScreen renders route Polyline, live 🚕 driver marker, ETA pill, and 'Unafika!' banner when driver within 200m
